resolution.summary: Inspected current DIP backlog and acceptance criteria. Ten defined development/research backlog tasks remain after L02/L04/L06/L08 completion; one unrelated internal suggestion record is separate. Relative easiest complete deliverable: L09 deterministic privacy/capture controls. L03 bounded recovery and L01 remaining live-host verification are next, with cross-platform/trusted-host constraints. Worktree coordination, matched quality/cost trials, semantic routing, model alternatives/custom training and distributed coordination are broader work. A pretrained-model pilot is a small initial milestone, not completion of the broad alternatives task. No development started or benchmark-quality benefit claimed.
